Good afternoon, Marlene! This market is huge. Is it bigger than the markets in Brazil?
No, the markets in São Paulo are bigger and busier. This one is more peaceful.
I love Florence, but the streets are very narrow. Is São Paulo older than Florence?
No, Florence is much older. São Paulo is huge, and Florence is tiny next to it.
Next week I want to visit a village on the coast. It is quieter than the city.
That sounds amazing! In January Brazil is warmer, so come and visit our beaches.
Good idea! And the coffee here? Is it better than Brazilian coffee?
No way! Brazilian coffee is stronger and better. But this cheese is wonderful.
Brazil is much bigger than Italy.

Good morning, everybody, and welcome to our Tuscany tour. Today we visit two places, Siena and a small village called Monteriggioni. Siena is bigger and busier, with many shops, museums and restaurants. Monteriggioni is tiny. Only about forty people live inside the old walls, so it is much quieter and more peaceful. The road to the village is narrow, and our bus is huge, so please be patient. From the hill you can see green fields everywhere. Lunch today is in Siena. The restaurant is more expensive than the cafe in the village, but the pasta is better. We are back in Florence at six o'clock. Enjoy the day.

Hi Marlene, it is Giulia from the hotel. You asked me about a weekend by the sea. I have two ideas for you. The first is Viareggio. It is closer to Florence, only one hour by train, and the beach is wide and long. But on Saturday it is very crowded. The second is a small village on the coast called Porto Ercole. It is farther, about three hours by car, but it is smaller, quieter and more beautiful. The hotels there are more expensive, so the trip is not cheaper. For a peaceful weekend, I think Porto Ercole is better. Call me if you want the address. Bye.

First, you leave the huge city of São Paulo and you fly to Italy. Then you arrive in Florence, and the narrow streets are quieter than at home. Next, you take a bus up the hill to a tiny village. After that, you have lunch in the village, and it is more peaceful than the city. Finally, you spend a weekend on the coast and you swim in the sea.
